card.title: General Manager, Data Operations
card.description:
**About David AI**
------------------

David AI is the first audio data research company. We bring an R&D approach to data–developing datasets with the same rigor AI labs bring to models. Our mission is to bring AI into the real world, and we believe audio is the gateway. Speech is versatile, accessible, and human—it fits naturally into everyday life. As audio AI advances and new use cases emerge, high-quality training data is the bottleneck. This is where David AI comes in.

David AI was founded in 2024 by a team of former Scale AI engineers and operators. In less than a year, we’ve brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. We recently raised a $50M Series B from Meritech, NVIDIA, Jack Altman (Alt Capital), Amplify Partners, First Round Capital and other Tier 1 investors.

Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight-knit. We’re looking for the best research, engineering, product, and operations minds to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI.

**About our Data Operations team**
----------------------------------

Our Data Operations team powers David AI's Data Factory, transforming raw audio into high-quality training datasets for leading AI labs. Our mandate is to spin up new data pipelines and run them at a massive scale.

This means starting from a model capability we want a model to unlock, experimenting with different shapes of data and collection strategies, and validating them with researchers. Once an approach works, we industrialize it, building pipelines that can process audio with reliability, quality, and efficiency. We are relentless operators who thrive in ambiguity, equally comfortable prototyping novel workflows as we are managing large-scale production systems.

**About this role**
-------------------

As General Manager of Data Operations, you will lead one of the most critical functions at David AI. You’ll own a major slice of our Data Factory: the engine that powers high-quality, scalable data production. You’ll lead the team responsible for building and scaling pipelines, from 0 1 experiments that unlock new model capabilities to 1 N industrialization that processes data reliably and efficiently.

**In this role, you will**
--------------------------

* Build and lead a team of Data Product Operations Leads, to spin up and scale data pipelines, from early experiments to production systems that generate high-quality audio data at scale.
* Act as a thought partner to executive leadership on how we can evolve and scale delivery capabilities in service of customer needs.
* Continuously monitor and improve pipeline health, spotting issues in sourcing, quality, or process early and owning solutions end-to-end.
* Use metrics to drive decisions, tracking throughput, quality, and cost to guide prioritization and identify where to scale or invest next.
* Work with researchers at leading AI labs to identify new model capabilities and turn them into concrete data workflows and project plans.
* Partner with our internal research team to design and test new data shapes that unlock frontier model capabilities.
* Own outcomes across functions, designing systems, managing execution, unblocking bottlenecks, and ensuring delivery at both prototype and production scale.

**Your background looks like**
------------------------------

* 5–10 years of experience in high-ownership roles (e.g., founder, GM, COO, or strategy/ops at a venture-backed startup).
* Prior experience scaling large-scale operational efforts at high-growth startups or fast-paced companies.
* Technical fluency with data and operations; SQL proficiency required.
* Prior experience designing and scaling systems, processes, and teams across different customer segments and product lines.
* A relentless operator with high standards, bias to action, and strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid pace; thrives in a “build while flying” environment.
* Low-ego, collaborative, and mission-driven, focused on team and company success.

**Bonus points if you have**
----------------------------

* Experience in data, ML, or large-scale operations.
* Background in CS, industrial engineering, or similar.

**Benefits**
------------

* Unlimited PTO.
* Top-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans.
* FSA & HSA access.
* 401k access.
* Meals 2x daily through DoorDash + snacks and beverages available at the office.
* Unlimited company-sponsored Barry’s classes.

**Visas**
---------

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B *transfers*, H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

Compensation Range: $205K - $235K

card.title: Director, AG Strategy & Operations
card.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**About the role & team**
-------------------------

We are building a central BU Authenticity Guarantee (AG) Centre of Excellence within eBay’s GFC organisation to strengthen the AG proposition and scale shared capabilities.

 
 

As **Director, AG Strategy & Operations**, you will report to the **GM, Portfolio Strategy & Operations — Global Focus Categories & Live**. You will examine and refine the cross-category strategy, lead and develop a high-performing team, and translate priorities into measurable business outcomes. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strategic judgment, operational understanding, and accountability for delivery—not just recommendations.

 
 

You will work closely alongside category divisions, which own category initiatives and commercial outcomes, and AuthOps, which manages authentication operations.

 
 

**What you will accomplish**
----------------------------

* **AG Strategy & Proposition:** Review and evolve the cross-category AG strategy, customer promise, and shared roadmap. Establish common experience standards and commercial guardrails, balancing consistency with category-specific needs.
* **Business Cases & Investment Prioritisation:** Build clear processes to develop, evaluate, and prioritise cases.Bring together category, finance, product, and AuthOps input to assess customer value, economics, operational feasibility, and expected returns.
* **Hands-On Execution:** Own cross-category initiatives from planning through delivery, with clear achievements and accountability. Spend time in AG centres to understand workflows, customer problems, and operational constraints, translating these insights into practical improvements with category teams and AuthOps.
* **Performance & Scalable Processes:** Establish critical metrics, operating reviews, and reusable launch and expansion playbooks.Track results against arguments, address gaps, and scale successful approaches across categories and markets.
* **People & Cross-Functional Leadership:** Lead and develop the team, aligning partners across category leadership, product, engineering, marketing, AuthOps, and other functions. Resolve dependencies, drive decisions, and communicate clear recommendations and progress to senior leadership.

**What you will bring**
-----------------------

* **Strategic & commercial judgment:** Significant experience in strategy, business operations, or general management, with strong business-case development, financial analysis, and investment prioritisation skills.
* **Execution & ownership:** A proven record of turning strategy into measurable results. A hands-on approach to understanding operations, solving problems, and delivering improvements, including willingness to travel to AG centres.
* **People & collaborator leadership:** Demonstrated success developing teams and influencing senior collaborators across business, product, and operations, with clear accountability for outcomes.
* **Analytical & communication skills:** Ability to translate data and customer insights into actionable recommendations and executive-ready communications. Experience in marketplaces, eCommerce, or customer trust is preferred; direct authentication experience is a plus.

**Why join us**
---------------

Help shape AG across eBay, building a team that connects customer trust with commercial growth and delivers improvements across categories and markets.

At eBay, our customers are our compass. We foster a culture where authenticity thrives, bold ideas are encouraged, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work.

**Additional Details**

The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:

$195,200 - $260,600

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employees will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Remote roles are not eligible for U.S. visa sponsorship.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center and AI Hiring Guideline.

**Job Description**

Here at Thermo Fisher Scientific, our industry-leading scale means unparalleled commercial reach, unique customer access, and a global footprint. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
* Must be able to pass a comprehensive background check, which includes a drug screening.

**Position Summary**

Reporting into this role are the leaders responsible for Service Product Management, Service Platforms, and our Global Technical Support leaders representing a global organization of approximately 100 colleagues.

This leader establishes the strategy, governance, and operational frameworks that enable service excellence through standardized processes, knowledge management, digital service platforms, technical support, escalation management, and service lifecycle governance. **Key Responsibilities**

**Global Service Capability Strategy**

* Define and execute the global strategy for service capabilities aligned with business growth objectives.
* Develop enterprise standards that improve service consistency, efficiency, and customer experience across all regions.
* Build scalable operational frameworks supporting future growth and digital transformation.
* Establish governance for global service capabilities and operational excellence initiatives.

**Service Lifecycle Management**

* Lead the global governance of service lifecycle management from New Product Introduction (NPI) through End-of-Life (EOL).
* Ensure global service readiness for new products, software, and technologies.
* Partner with Product Management and Engineering to establish supportability requirements early in product development.
* Standardize lifecycle planning, service documentation, training, spare parts readiness, and support models.

**Knowledge Management & Service Enablement**

* Own the global knowledge management strategy supporting service engineers and technical support organizations.
* Develop standardized technical content, troubleshooting guides, repair procedures, and digital knowledge assets.
* Drive adoption of Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) principles to improve service effectiveness.
* Ensure service knowledge remains accurate, accessible, and continuously improved.

**Technical Support & Escalation Management**

* Lead the global technical support organization responsible for advanced troubleshooting and issue resolution.
* Establish enterprise escalation governance for complex customer and product issues.
* Drive root cause analysis in partnership with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and Product teams.
* Ensure lessons learned from escalations translate into improved products, documentation, and service processes.

**Service Platforms & Digital Enablement**

* Lead strategy and adoption for global service platforms and digital service technologies.
* Partner with Digital and IT organizations to define the future roadmap for service enablement platforms.
* Drive adoption of field service technologies, analytics, workflow automation, and AI-enabled service capabilities.
* Ensure platforms support efficient, standardized service execution globally.

**Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Build leadership capability across Service Product Management, Technical Support, Service Platforms, and Service Operations.
* Foster a collaborative, customer-focused culture emphasizing accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Champion organizational development, succession planning, and talent growth across the global service capability organization.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Life Sciences, or related field required.
* MBA or Master's degree preferred.

**Experience**

* 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in global service organizations, technical support, customer success, or operational excellence.
* Experience leading enterprise service capabilities within complex global matrix organizations.
* Demonstrated success building global operating models and scalable service capabilities.
* Strong understanding of service lifecycle management, technical support, knowledge management, and digital service technologies.
* Experience leading organizational transformation and enterprise change initiatives.
* Financial and operational management experience, including forecasting, investment prioritization, and productivity improvement.

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus scheme, healthcare, company 401k, and a range of employee benefits! Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation.

Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform critical job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

**Compensation and Benefits**

The salary range estimated for this position based in Massachusetts is $165,000.00–$200,000.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

card.description:
Kentucky Trailer

As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.

Job Title: Director of Operations
 
Division: Kentucky Trailer 
Location: Louisville, KY- 3 site locations 
Reports to: President, Kentucky Trailer 
FLSA: Exempt 
 
This position has multiple direct reports across 3 sites. Current direct reports include Operations Manager, 7 Team Leaders, and a Manufacturing Engineer/Facilities Manager. This position requires local travel between the 3 sites in Louisville. 
 
Kentucky Trailer has been building in Louisville since 1879, when it was founded as the Kentucky Wagon Manufacturing Company. Today it designs and builds custom trailers and truck bodies for moving and storage, snack food distribution, package delivery, and specialty markets such as mobile medical, government, and motorsports. Most of what we build is engineered to order rather than off the shelf, which makes our operations both challenging and rewarding to lead. 
 
The Director of Operations leads all day-to-day manufacturing operations and is accountable for Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, People, and Productivity results. The role owns the manufacturing operating budget, develops frontline leaders, and builds a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Works closely with Materials, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, Human Resources, and Commercial Sales to make sure production plans are executable and customer commitments are met. The workforce is non-union.

**Position Key Accountabilities:**

### **Safety**

* Create and sustain a Safety First and Always culture, with every employee understanding their personal responsibility for a safe workplace.
* Enforce safety policies, procedures and safe work practices at every level of the organization.
* Make sure hazards, near misses and incidents are addressed promptly, with root causes corrected.
* Ensure compliance with OSHA and environmental requirements and lead continuous improvement toward an incident-free workplace.

### **Manufacturing performance and planning**

* Lead daily manufacturing activities to meet production schedules and customer delivery commitments.
* Set clear daily, weekly and monthly expectations for each production area, and align labor and resources to requirements.
* Identify production constraints and implement corrective actions to improve throughput.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Materials so schedules are executable and escalate shortages before they affect production.
* Support point-of-use inventory, Kanban, vendor-managed inventory and other Lean material strategies where appropriate.

### **Quality**

* Build a culture where quality is owned at the point of manufacture and the next operation is treated as the customer.
* Ensure compliance with manufacturing standards, specifications, work instructions and quality procedures.
* Partner with Engineering to drive root-cause corrective action and reduce defects, rework, warranty exposure and cost of poor quality.

### **Lean and operational excellence**

* Champion Lean Manufacturing using 5S, Standard Work, Visual Management, Kaizen and structured problem solving.
* Establish a disciplined management cadence of daily production meetings, visual boards, KPI reviews and structured follow-up.
* Ensure standard work is documented, followed and continuously improved.
* Drive measurable improvement in labor productivity, cycle time, throughput, material flow, space utilization and manufacturing cost.
* Lead automation and capital initiatives that improve safety, quality, productivity and cost.

### **Financial performance and cost**

* Own the manufacturing operating budget and take part in the annual budget and monthly forecasts.
* Manage to labor, overhead and operating cost targets, including direct labor productivity, overtime and indirect labor.
* Ensure accuracy in both labor reporting and BOM usages
* WIP accuracy, and operational support for cycle counts and physical inventories.
* Partner with Finance to analyze manufacturing variances and carry out corrective actions.
* Prepare ROI justifications for capital requests and track whether completed projects deliver the promised return.

### **Maintenance and facilities**

* Ensure preventive maintenance programs maximize equipment uptime and extend asset life.
* Improve utilization of equipment, facilities and manufacturing capacity.

### **Leadership and people development**

* Lead, coach and develop managers, team leaders and employees across the operation.
* Set annual performance goals and development plans and hold leaders accountable for results.
* Build frontline leaders' capability in problem solving, waste elimination and employee accountability.
* Build organizational depth through hiring, succession planning and cross-training.
* Communicate regularly with employees about performance, company expectations, policies and priorities.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Manufacturing or another technical discipline, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 10 years in manufacturing with a proven record of success and increasing responsibility.
* Minimum 5 years leading multi-site operations through managers and leaders.
* Demonstrated record of improving safety performance
* Lean Manufacturing experience or certification, with measurable results in efficiency improvement and cost reduction.
* Demonstrated P&L or operating budget accountability.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities at once.
* Willingness to live and work in the greater Louisville, KY area.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Trailer, truck body or similar fabrication, welding and assembly experience.
* Experience in high-mix, custom build-to-order manufacturing.
* MBA or other financial education.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

This role works in both office and manufacturing plant settings, with exposure to noise, welding, painting and moving equipment. Required PPE must be worn on the production floor. The role regularly requires walking and standing for extended periods.

Employment is contingent on successful completion of a background check and drug screen.

Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to careers@marmon.com, and please be sure to include the title and the location of the position for which you are applying.

card.title: Regional Director, Operations
card.description:
Tennessee Oncology, one of the nation’s largest, community-based cancer care specialists, is home to one of the leading clinical trial networks in the country. Established 1976 in Nashville, Tennessee Oncology’s mission remains unchanged: To provide access to high-quality cancer care and the expertise of clinical research for all patients, at convenient locations within their community and close to their home. Our growing network of physicians and locations is based on this mission. Tennessee Oncology is committed to advancing both the science of detection and targeted treatments, and to making these advances available to every patient. We believe caring for cancer patients is a privilege.

Why Join Us? We are looking for talented and highly-motivated individuals who demonstrate a natural desire to support the meaningful work of community oncologists and the patients we serve.

**Job Description:**

The Regional Director of Clinical Operations is responsible for directing, supervising, and coordinating staff and activities at multiple clinics to provide quality, cost-effective care. May also be responsible for business development and establishing/maintaining positive working relationships with community leaders and hospital leadership.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

* Supervises all Operations Managers**/**Regional Operations Managers for assigned region and others as directed.
* Manages daily operations at assigned clinic(s) and coordinates the work activities and schedules.
* Ensures provisions of safe, high-quality patient care by the staff.
* Evaluates performance and recommends candidates for hire, merit increases, promotions, and disciplinary actions.
* Ensures that office space, supplies, equipment, and assistance are provided and maintained appropriately for medical staff and patient care.
* Ensures that all business functions are operative and that all processes are effectively and efficiently in place. Identifies and implements process improvement changes. Creates goals for clinic operations and ensures that these goals are in line with organizational goals.
* Maximizes opportunities to manage operating costs.
* Works closely with Providers and MD Partners ensuring all clinic and company goals are met.
* Contributes to the writing and revision of company policies, procedures, job descriptions and competencies etc.
* Maintains an active and/or leadership role in company projects and initiatives and ensures implementation and integration in clinics.
* Oversees Regional Safety and Compliance for all governing agents in collaboration with other Managers and Directors to include but not limited to: OSHA, QOPI, PQRS, and Meaningful Use etc.
* Creates and maintains an environment of trust, integrity, open communication, teamwork and respect.
* Works collaboratively with vendors, contractors, building maintenance and others that interact with all regional clinics.
* Oversight of payroll for direct reports and Performance Excellence Plans.
* Responsible for mentoring, coaching and development of direct reports.
* Brainstorms action planning in an effort to improve scores of the Employee engagement survey.
* Works with managers of all clinics in reviewing and analyzing patient satisfaction and developing action plans for improvement.
* Has superior skills in building relationships with Providers.
* Relates well to all types of people using diplomacy and tact in team building.
* Regularly rounds in clinics to assure high visibility and develop trusting relationships with staff and to ensure validation that changes, and initiatives are fully engrained.
* Works collaboratively with department directors/leaders to achieve operational/projects initiatives, goals and outcomes.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

*Knowledge:*

* Knowledge of fiscal management and human resource management techniques.
* Knowledge of office management techniques and practices.

*Skills:*

* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
* Setting, defining, assigning, monitoring, and evaluating outcomes of tasks and goals.

*Abilities:*

* Ability to clearly communicate and apply policies and principles to solve everyday problems and deal with a variety of situations.
* Ability to plan, exercise initiative, problem solve, make decisions.
* Ability to read, interpret, and apply clinic policies and procedures.
* Ability to identify problems and recommend solutions.
* Ability to establish priorities and coordinate work activities.
* Ability to manage financial information.

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:**

Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business administration, nursing or related field. Prefer Master’s degree.

Prefer 3-5 years Oncology office management experience preferred, including at least 2 years in a clinic setting. Strongly prefer experience managing multiple locations

card.title: Director of Operations
card.description:
**Reporting:** 
Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

**Direct Reports:** 
Area Manager(s)

**Leadership Scope:** 
Provides leadership and oversight to all Operations team members, including Senior Multi-Unit Managers, Multi-Unit Managers, Hourly Managers, and Guest Service Hosts.

**Description:**

The Vice President of Operations is the steward of our organizational identity, bridging the field and support center teams. They spend time in the field listening to frontline employees, then bring those insights to the executive table to shape decisions. In turn, they translate corporate priorities into clear, purposeful action for each location following the principles of Unreasonable Hospitality.

More than anything, they are the guardian of what makes us *us*: the values, traditions, and shared ways of working that bind our people together. They ensure those values are felt in every location by recognizing great work, modeling expected behaviors, and making sure every employee feels seen, heard, and proud to belong.

This role has two main objectives: setting and executing the company’s operational strategy across its retail video gaming (VGT) locations, and building and leading the Operations leadership team. It requires a service-oriented, strategic, and results-driven executive who prioritizes guest satisfaction while ensuring smooth, compliant, and profitable operations that support the company’s long-term growth.

**Expectations:**

* Lead with integrity and honesty in all work-related duties and set the standard for the organization.
* Provide proactive, strategic leadership over the operations of all company locations.
* Empower and support the Operations team to meet or exceed performance standards.
* Maintain a deep working knowledge of every area of operations and step in to assist when necessary.
* Develop a positive and collaborative work environment for employees, guests, vendors, and regulators.
* Ensure the company meets state, local, and company standards and regulations, including gaming and liquor requirements.
* Maintain clear and consistent communication with the CEO, executive team, employees, managers, and stakeholders.

**Responsibilities:**

**Executive Leadership and Culture**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to the executive team and participate in setting company vision, strategy, and annual goals.
* Be a champion of company culture by leading with integrity, kindness, and a strong commitment to company values.
* Foster a mentor mentality by teaching and leading by example, asking questions to ensure clarity, and consistently following up to reinforce learning and ensure progress.
* Build, coach, and hold accountable the Operations team.
* Lead succession planning and talent development across all levels of operations leadership.
* Provide regular operational and financial updates to the executive team.

**Operations and Guest Experience**

* Take ownership of operations across all locations and establish company-wide standards for guest service, cleanliness, and sanitation.
* Teach, demonstrate, and guide the organization toward exceptional guest service, creating memorable experiences every shift, every day, every time.
* Drive operational efficiency through impactful leadership and accountability at all levels, identifying opportunities and resolving challenges to ensure smooth, continuous operations.
* Establish and monitor operating procedures for inventory, ordering, scheduling, timecards, and store audits, and verify they are consistently followed.
* Be knowledgeable of VGT machines, slot games, and features, and ensure teams are equipped to resolve machine issues.
* Evaluate and implement process improvements that increase efficiency and consistency across locations.

**People Management**

* Partner with Human Resources to ensure proper staffing levels, training and development of team members, disciplinary actions, and overall performance management.
* Establish compensation, staffing, and labor-budget guidelines for operations in partnership with the CEO and Human Resources.
* Maintain consistent communication with all levels of the organization, including in-person visits, camera monitoring, phone calls, and team meetings.
* Facilitate regular meetings with the Area Manager(s), Operations team, and business partners to ensure thorough follow-through on all business needs.
* Support a culture of continuous training and development for new and existing team members.

**Financial Performance**

* Own the company's operating P&L, including VGT performance and controllable expenses, ensuring results stay within budget while driving profitability.
* Develop annual operating budgets, and capital plans in partnership with the CEO and CFO.
* Analyze monthly P&Ls and key performance indicators and hold the leadership team accountable for results.
* Ensure strong internal controls over cash handling, deposit processes, and sales activities across all locations.

**Licensing, Compliance, and Regulatory Relations**

* Oversee the company's licensing and compliance program to ensure adherence to state and local regulations and standards.
* Serve as a key point of contact with regulators, including the Illinois Gaming Board (IGB), and maintain professional relationships with regulatory and local authorities.
* Uphold company policies and licensing standards, including liquor and gaming regulations, to protect employees and guests.
* Ensure a safe and compliant work environment by following local health codes and business license regulations.
* Ensure all employees complete required certification courses and that audits are completed and corrective actions are followed through.
* Reinforce a zero-tolerance standard to prohibit underage patrons from purchasing alcohol or gambling by IDing every guest, every time.

**Growth, Market Strategy, and Marketing**

* Identify and evaluate opportunities for growth, including new locations and market expansion.
* Analyze each local market through competitive shops, daily reports, and monthly revenue reports from the IGB.
* Champion marketing initiatives and promotional campaigns, ensuring effective implementation across all locations.
* Provide strategic direction to the leadership team to drive successful marketing initiatives and promotions.

**Safety, Security, and Systems**

* Maintain a safe working environment by overseeing safety programs, ensuring concerns are reported and resolved.
* Ensure key and alarm code tracking, camera monitoring, and security procedures are followed at all locations.
* Ensure internal systems such as ShiftNotes, Guardian, and the Point-of-Sale system are maintained and updated.

**Facilities, Vendors, and Risk Management**

* Oversee repair and maintenance programs to ensure equipment, facilities, and systems operate efficiently.
* Take a proactive approach to identifying and addressing operational risk before problems escalate.
* Manage key vendor, contractor, and partner relationships, including negotiating and reviewing service agreements in partnership with the CEO.

**Other Duties**

* Perform other duties as requested by the CEO.

**Skills & Experience:**

* Must be 21 years of age.
* Extensive multi-unit or multi-location leadership experience, including leading managers and directors.
* Experience in gaming, hospitality, restaurant, or retail operations is preferred.
* Proven track record of owning a P&L, budgeting, forecasting, and driving profitable growth.
* Working knowledge of gaming and liquor regulations, including Illinois Gaming Board requirements, strongly preferred.
* Strong executive presence with excellent communication, interpersonal, and team leadership skills.
* Must have access to reliable transportation and be available to travel to all locations during business hours.
* Must be able to bend, reach, lift, and/or carry 50 pounds.
* Must be able to maintain an active and engaged floor presence for periods exceeding 60 minutes.
* Attend meetings and trainings as required.

card.description:
**About Us**

Born in 1993, Excelsia Injury Care’s mission is to restore quality of life through patient-centric care and support for those injured in motor vehicle or work-related accidents. With over 100 patient care centers across the Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, and Mountain West regions, our vision is to be the leading provider of injury care, setting the standard for excellence in every community we serve and expanding access to high-quality care nationwide.

At Excelsia, we deliver the full continuum of outpatient care within one seamless, connected system. Our diverse team of medical specialists offers a wide range of treatment services, covering medical, orthopedics, neurology, rehabilitation, diagnostic, and surgical. We are committed to supporting patients through personalized support, detailed documentation, and outcome-oriented care coordination to make the recovery process easier. With Excelsia, patients are never far from the care they need—with the compassion they deserve.

Founded on the values of respect and trustworthiness, we are committed to delivering services that adhere to the highest legal, regulatory, and ethical standards. As responsible corporate citizens, we integrate environmental, social, and governance (ESG) considerations into our business practices, ensuring that we positively impact the healthcare companies we serve, our employees, and the communities we reach.

**\*\*\*Please know this position requires 100% travel throughout our Greater Baltimore Market\*\*\***

**Job Duties**

* Leads their respective regions to ensure smooth operation of medical offices.
* Participate in the coordination of logistics (with the support of the Executive Assistant) for all provider and manager meetings.
* Act as a liaison between Compliance, BSO staff, and providers to ensure that audits and retraining are completed (e.g., dictation).
* Investigate patient complaints that are reported to Compliance related to operational issues.
* Assists in ensuring that operations tasks related to integrations are completed prior to the required milestone dates.
* Manages a variety of projects to be assigned by the market president.
* Hire, train, and provide development opportunities for nonclinical staff of medical offices.
* Act as an escalation point for clinical office managers and providers.
* Provide their teams with the data needed to have line of sight into the overall operational health of their assigned offices.
* Weekly onsite presence at all locations.
* Ensures financial and operational objectives of offices are realized.
* Ensure that each member within their region is performing all duties in his or her job description.
* Implement protocols identified by Compliant related to HIPAA, regulations, and company processes.
* Improve office processes and manage the implementations.
* Ensure financial and operational objectives of offices are realized.
* Monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) daily and react to needs.
* Provide regular reporting in accordance with Excelsia standards.
* Conducts regularly scheduled one-on-one meetings with direct reports to provide support, address challenges, and foster professional growth.

* Leads recurring team meetings and ensures timely completion of annual performance reviews, delivering constructive feedback to support individual and team development.
* Lead with integrity by upholding our core values and ensuring that all operations align with legal, regulatory, and ethical standards. Foster a culture of corporate responsibility by incorporating Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles into business practices, positively impacting the patients we serve, our employees, and the communities we reach.
* Perform other duties and assignments as directed and/or as necessary.

##### **Minimum Requirements**

* High school Graduate or GED equivalent
* Bachelor’s degree in related field preferred
* Knowledge of advanced work-related subjects
* Successful completion of corporate orientation program
* Ongoing related continuing education participation
* Five or more years in a related supervisory capacity
* 1-2 years of medical experience in an administrative/legal/ physician office setting
* Previous computer skills to include (data entry, word perfect, etc.)

##### **Additional Skills/Competencies**

* Ability to maintain a strong confidentiality profile
* Ability to project a strong corporate image
* Ability to recognize emergency medical and non-medical situations
* Ability to identify and resolve customer relation problems
* Ability to identify and resolve clinical problems.
* Ability to remain calm in emergency situations
* Ability to form interpersonal relationships (i.e., establish rapport with others)
* Ability to manage time effectively by setting priorities
* Ability to anticipate problems before they arise.
* Ability to anticipate patient/physician/corporate needs
* Mathematical ability to perform required calculations.

##### **Physical/Mental Requirements**

* Ability to work flexible hours as required by job demands.
* May include some exposure to infection and injury
* Manual dexterity hand/eye coordination
* Able to lift a minimum of 10 pounds independently
* Able to perform frequent work with hand/wrist movement
* Prolonged sitting for up to 60% of time.

##### **Motor Vehicle Report Monitoring**

In the event Employee does not maintain the insurance coverage required under this Policy & Procedure, and/or does not maintain a valid license to operate a motor vehicle, that Employee shall not be eligible for mileage reimbursement and is barred from operating any motor vehicle in furtherance of Company business. Operating a motor vehicle in furtherance of Company business without a valid state-issued driver’s license to do so and/or maintain insurance of the type and amounts set forth herein shall subject the Employee to immediate disciplinary action up to and including termination.

**Why work for Excelsia Injury Care? We offer a competitive salary, a great and stable work environment as well as amazing benefit package! Offered Benefits include:**

* Medical, Dental and Vision plans through CareFirst with PPO And HSA options available the first of the month after your hire date.
* Rich leave benefits including PTO that is accrued starting on your first day of work, 8 company-recognized paid holidays plus a floating holiday, and 5 days of sick leave each calendar year.
* Employee Assistance Program, Earned Wage Access, and Employee Assistance Fund.
* Discounts on shopping and travel perks through WorkingAdvantage.
* 401(k) retirement plan with employer match.
* Paid training opportunities and Education Assistance Program.
* Employee Referral Bonus Program

**Diversity Statement**

Excelsia Injury Care is an equal opportunity employer. We commit to a policy of nondiscrimination and equal opportunity for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, pregnancy or related medical conditions, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic predisposition, marital, civil union or partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other consideration protected by federal, state or local laws.

Equal Opportunity Employer 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

card.description:
The Director of Operation’s duties, roles and responsibilities are dynamic. The Director of Operations is responsible for optimizing operation costs, ensuring safety, financial performance, and achieving quality, specifically for our North American Rail facilities. This role supports the team, coaches, and promotes individual staff development, and acts as a company representative internally and externally, and works closely with Corporate shared services to ensure processes and procedures that are consistent with LB Foster’s principles. Other responsibilities include managing daily operations, planning how both material and human resources are to be utilized, and leading transformational change.

**Responsibilities (Essential Functions):**

* Managing the day-to-day operations of the business focusing the company on the fundamentals of sound business methodologies and continuous improvement for multiple facilities and yards, including Niles, Pueblo, Columbia City and Burnaby.

* Evaluate the performance of the organization in meeting objectives and determine where costs can be reduced, what can be improved and what should be changed.

* Work with executive leadership to establish and provide direction for short and long range organizational goals and objectives.

* Driving and continuing to build and nurture an aggressive performance-oriented culture.

* Strategically adjusts plant activities, policies, and practices to meet or exceed key performance metrics and customer satisfaction goals.

* Continue to upgrade company processes and procedures to reach supply chain synergies between the various plants, including inventory management.

* Directing operational excellence through “continuous improvement” activities in engineering, procurement, and production management, with the aim to drive additional lean manufacturing initiatives and cut production costs.

* Interacting with plant leadership, accounting, and the SVP – Rail by providing timely financial and operating reporting.

* Continuing to develop, mentor, and build a first-class team as the business expands its geographic footprint and drive a cultural shift in the company towards operational excellence.

**Experience, Education, & License Requirements:**

* A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or related required. Master’s Degree is a plus.
* 10 plus years of professional experience with demonstrated progressive levels of management experience
* 5 plus years of technical manufacturing knowledge required
* Six Sigma certification a plus

**Skills & Abilities:**

* Exemplary interpersonal and communication skills.
* Strong organizational, decision making, negotiating, problem solving and interpersonal skills
* High-ethical standards demonstrated by the individual’s reputation for high integrity in business and the ability to set that tone for the entire business.
* Strong understanding of P&L.
* Can lead effectively by driving objectives and results while maintaining the “people first” culture and engaging others.
* The ability to demonstrate knowledge of Lean principles, Six-sigma and manufacturing best practices

**Competencies:**

card.description:
**Senior Manager – Reman & Refurb Operations**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Senior Manager – Reman & Refurb Operations leads the development, execution, and growth of SANY America’s component remanufacturing and full-machine refurbishment operations. This position oversees shop performance, safety, quality, cost, inventory, suppliers, and dealer support while building a scalable, profitable operation that improves machine uptime and lifecycle value.

With current revenues over $500 million, SANY America continues to make strong progress and significant investments in the Americas market; the organization is now pursuing an aggressive growth strategy and is looking to move quickly beyond this initial platform and increase their market share.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Business Strategy & Operations**

* Develop and execute the U.S. remanufacturing and refurbishment roadmap, including future certified refurbished equipment programs.

* Direct production planning, technician utilization, shop capacity, workflows, turnaround times, and performance standards.

* Build and coach technical and operations teams, establishing clear ownership, training, and accountability.

**Remanufacturing & Refurbishment**

* Standardize machine inspection, teardown, repair, component replacement, testing, cosmetic restoration, and final acceptance.

* Expand viable remanufacturing offerings for engines, hydraulics, powertrain, electronics, and other high-value assemblies.

* Establish documented repair procedures, quality gates, testing standards, failure analysis, and corrective actions.

**Financial & Inventory Management**

* Own operating budgets, rebuild costs, labor standards, margin performance, scrap reduction, and repair-versus-replace decisions.

* Develop core return, valuation, salvage, used-component, and reman inventory controls to improve recovery and reduce working capital.

* Track operational and financial KPIs, including cycle time, capacity, first-pass quality, revenue, and profitability.

**Suppliers, Dealers & Cross-Functional Support**

* Manage outside rebuild suppliers and technical partners against quality, cost, warranty, and lead-time expectations.

* Partner with Service, Parts, Warranty, Product, Sales, Finance, and dealers to support customer uptime and refurbishment opportunities.

* Support certified refurbished equipment programs through condition grading, inspection documentation, and warranty coordination.

**Safety & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain a safe, organized, compliant shop with appropriate PPE, equipment controls, and safe work practices.

* Implement Lean, 5S, standard work, visual management, root cause analysis, and ongoing process improvements.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, or related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

* 12+ years of progressive experience in remanufacturing, refurbishment, heavy equipment, automotive, industrial manufacturing, service operations, or a related field.

* 6+ years of direct people-management or operations-leadership experience.

* Strong understanding of engines, hydraulics, powertrain, electrical systems, and heavy equipment troubleshooting.

* Proven ability to manage production, quality, inventory, capacity, costs, KPIs, and financial performance.

* Strong communication, problem-solving, cross-functional leadership, and analytical skills.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience launching or expanding remanufacturing, machine rebuild, refurbishment, or certified pre-owned operations.

* Construction or off-highway equipment experience, including supplier and third-party rebuild partner management.

* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, 5S, ERP, inventory, service, and warranty system experience.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

**OFFICE + OPERATIONS WORK ENVIRONMENT**

This role is primarily office-based with regular work in remanufacturing, refurbishment, and equipment service areas. Duties may involve extended computer use, standing, walking, and observing or inspecting heavy machinery, tools, and shop operations. Exposure to noise, moving equipment, and varying temperatures may occur. Required personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn in designated areas, with or without reasonable accommodation.

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

Occasional travel to SANY facilities, suppliers, dealers, and customer sites as business needs require.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

Compensation will be competitive and commensurate with experience.

* Medical, dental, and vision

* Paid Time Off

* 401(k) savings plans

* Health Savings Account (HSA)

* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)

* Company paid STD and LTD benefits

* Life Insurance

* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT**

SANY America is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected status under applicable federal, state, or local law.

**DRUG AND ALCOHOL-FREE WORKPLACE NOTICE**

SANY America is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a drug and alcohol-free workplace consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Applicants may be required to complete pre-employment screenings, including drug and/or alcohol testing, as a condition of employment where permitted by applicable law. Testing requirements, employment practices, and workplace policies may vary based on work location, position responsibilities, business necessity, workplace safety considerations, customer requirements, contractual obligations, and applicable regulatory standards.

 

SANY America complies with applicable federal, state, and local laws relating to marijuana/cannabis use, including applicable medical and recreational marijuana laws where permitted. However, applicants and employees are prohibited from being impaired or under the influence of alcohol, illegal drugs, or other prohibited substances while working, operating Company vehicles or equipment, performing safety sensitive duties, conducting Company business, or while on Company property, consistent with applicable law.

 

Certain positions may be designated as safety sensitive or subject to additional regulatory, customer, contractual, operational, or workplace safety requirements and may require participation in pre-employment, random, reasonable suspicion, post-accident, return to duty, follow up, or other drug and/or alcohol testing programs in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Circle of Life is growing, and we have an opening for a Regional Director of Operations to join our team. This position will oversee and manage our New Mexico branches; Albuquerque, Gallup, Kirtland, Shiprock, and Zuni.

**Good for employees**

Circle of Life’s focus is creating a workplace where respect, appreciation and teamwork are the shared experiences of our team. We do good for our employees by collaborating on scheduling, a focus on wellbeing, a client-first directive, respecting and valuing every team member, having fun along with top industry compensation and benefits.

**Good deeds**

We also do good in our work. Our team of office and field staff care about each other and the clients we serve. We help one another. We care and provide for a wide range of patients with a focus on serving the underserved.

**Position duties include**

* Participate in the hiring and training of managers
* Organize and oversee the work and schedules of managers
* Conduct performance evaluations
* Handle discipline of employees as needed following company policy
* Establish quantitative and qualitative metrics, guidelines, and standards by which the company's efficiency and effectiveness can be evaluated (identify opportunities for improvement)
* Implement policies and procedures that will improve day-to-day operations
* Oversee office operations, ensuring each branch is reaching goals set by departmental and company leadership
* Monitors budget and revenue in each office to achieve financial objectives
* Communicates and explains new directives, policies/procedures to manager for change and meets with staff to explain changes, answer questions, and maintain morale
* Improve customer service and satisfaction
* Market current products to potential clients, families, case workers and potential referral sources
* Leads coordination and integration of efforts among homecare teams to produce smoother workflow and more cost-effective business processes
* Traveling is required

**Qualifications**

Qualified applicants will have 3 years of management experience, excellent verbal and written communication skills and interpersonal and customer service skills. Healthcare and/or home care experience preferred. The Regional Director of Operations oversees the day-to-day activities for their assigned branches, ensuring the organization is managed and performing efficiently and effectively. While carrying out the responsibilities of the position, ensure the values of servant-leadership, empathy, altruism, and integrity are evident in all actions and encounters.

**How good?**

* Positively change the lives of individuals and families in our communities
* Serve the underserved providing access to care for those who have been traditionally overlooked by the health care system
* Support a talented team of administrative and clinical professionals and be a part of a team that supports each other

**Full Benefits include**

* Medical, Dental, 401K, Paid Holidays, Top PTO Plan, Mileage, Flexible Schedules, Vision, Year-End Bonus

**Job Overview**

Remote imaging group is looking for a Director of Operations who will be responsible for all practice operations, supporting radiologists, and interfacing between the practice and customers.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead operational excellence initiatives, process improvement, and business management efforts across teams.
* Lead all aspect of pratice operations and act as liaison between customer hospital systems and radiologists.
* Manage IT software and equipment. Work directly with managed vendors to ensure efficient daily operations.
* Monitor and audit practice key performance indicators and accounts receiveable.
* Report directly into CMO and other Executive Directors.

**Requirements**

* Heavy experience in a fast paced radiology practice is a requirement.
* Experience in hospital based physician management, hosptial and practice operations management, revenue cycle management, credentialing, and physician licensing.
* Skills in executive-level budget management, budgeting, forecasting, and financial management.
* Ability to manage projects, programs, process improvement, and change management initiatives.
* Strong verbal communication with physicians, front office staff, and executives; business development experience is preferred.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $140,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
